Hi Susan — thanks for sending the docs. A few quick notes from procurement: 

1) Legal name: please confirm the exact legal_entity you want on the PO. From your note use "ClearWave Logistics, Inc."
2) Tax ID formatting: Ariba typically ignores dashes, but some supplier portals are strict. Please resend the EIN without the dash (123456789) just to rule that out.
3) SSO/SAML: if your IT team uses SAML/IdP for SSO into Ariba, there are cases where the IdP name claim doesn't match the legal_entity field. If you have an IdP admin we should include them on the kickoff.
4) Bank verification: the bank letter you sent shows account name matching, which is good. We'll redact the file before we store it in our system.

I'll open a ticket with Ariba support (Ivalua/Coupa are similar but here Ariba tenant is the target) and include the error screenshot. That ticket will help surface whether the issue is an ingestion/mapping problem on Redwood's side vs ClearWave's portal entry.

Action items (owners):
- Susan: resend EIN without dash and confirm legal entity exactly (Susan)
- ClearWave: confirm whether they use SAML/IdP for portal logins (Susan)
- Monica: open ticket with Ariba support and provide ETA (Monica)
- Ben: stand by to do manual vendor creation if ticket won't clear same day (Ben)
